cohort: 450 healthy neonates born at the gestational age of >= 35 weeks.
finding: UCS bilirubin level could not predict subsequent hyperbilirubinemia, whereas predischarge bilirubin level and clinical risk factors (gestational age, birth weight, history of jaundice in siblings, and mode of delivery) were significantly correlated with postnatal hyperbilirubinemia.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a significant clinical risk factor for postnatal hyperbilirubinemia.
